Call for Proposals: Arena's Academic Partnerships Program, Fall 2026

Arena's Academic Partnerships Program opens a call for research proposals twice a year, every Spring and Fall. We're excited to open the Fall 2026 cycle today, with submissions due October 30, 2026.

Arena's mission is to measure and advance the frontier of AI through open, rigorous, and community-driven evaluation. Independent academic research is central to that mission, and this program exists to support it directly.

The program provides funding of up to $50,000 per project to tenure-track faculty at U.S.-based universities pursuing research in evaluation and ranking methodology, measurement and validity, learning from human preference, or safety and alignment. Responses are typically sent within 8 weeks of the submission deadline. Teams and individuals are encouraged to apply.

If you're doing independent research on the scientific foundations of AI evaluation, submit a proposal here.

Read more about the first cohort of Arena Academic Fellows: Spring 2026 recipients and their research projects here.
